title: The Cesti (fragments of books 7, 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, and 13)
edition: PG 10; Cesti fragmenta (Khazarzar extract of books 7, 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, and 13)
author: Julius Africanus
blurb: Julius Africanus, Cesti (Embroidered Girdles). Tip of the locked PG 10 fragment: books 7, 2, 3, 4.1, 8.2, 9.1–9.5, Cestus 18's colophon, and 13.22. New English from locked Greek. Book-2 pinax and a book-7 appendix after the colophon are not in this volume (no 3.20 in the lock). No previous English of the Cesti body is known; ANF translates the letters only.
era_note: Sextus Julius Africanus, Christian chronographer and encyclopedist, early third century. This page is a tip of the locked fragment, not the whole Cesti.
first_english_note: No complete English of the Cesti body is known. ANF (Roberts) translates Africanus's letters, not this encyclopedic fragment. This is a new rendering from locked PG 10 Greek.

text_history.method: New English from locked PG 10 / Khazarzar Greek of the Cesti fragmenta through 9.5. Earlier lemma-led scaffold English was discarded. Book-2 pinax and book-7 appendix held. This lock is exhausted.
